newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canada, Algeria sign loan deal.
newsitem.headline: Canada, Algeria sign loan deal.

text.p: Canada and Algeria Sunday signed a loan agreement and credit guarantee accord for the North African country worth $170 million.
The official Algerian news agency APS said the agreements were signed during a visit by Canada's International Cooperation Minister Don Boudria.
The $100 million loan accord was signed between the Algerian Development Bank and the Canadian Society for the Expansion of Exports, APS said.
The other agreement gave a $70 million credit line to Algeria's oil and gas firm Sonatrach.

A joint statement said both countries want to "intensify consultation at ministerial level and noted wide prospects to develop cooperation, particularly in trade, investments, partnerships, and technical cooperation."
Boudria, who wound up his visit on Sunday, held talks with Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia and other government officials.
